$description: Fincaree B2B Design System — index of all exported Figma token files

collections.name: x_Primitives
collections.description: Raw hex color values — brand, grey, status (error/warning/success/info), secondary palettes, overlays, and base colors. Single mode. Never reference directly from components — always via semantic aliases.

collections.name: 1.Semantic color modes
collections.description: Semantic color aliases for all UI roles: Text, Icon, Background, Border, Foreground, Overlay, Focus Ring, Chart, Sidebar. Switches between Light Mode and Dark Mode. This is the layer components and code should reference for color.

collections.name: 2.Radius
collections.description: Border radius scale: None (0px) through Full (9999px). Single mode.

collections.name: 3.Spacing
collections.description: Spacing scale from Spacing/0 (0px) to Spacing/1200 (96px). Used for padding, gap, and margin. Single mode.

collections.name: 4.Screen widths
collections.description: Responsive breakpoints: Screen/XS (320px) through Screen/3XL (1600px). Primary design target is Screen/XL (1280px).

collections.name: 5.Typography
collections.description: Font size, line height, letter spacing, font weight (number), font family, and font style (string) tokens. Font family is Geist. Single mode.

collections.name: 6.Z Index
collections.description: Z-index layering scale: Base (0) → Sticky (100) → Dropdown (200) → Popover (300) → Modal (400) → Toast (500) → Tooltip (600). Single mode.

collections.name: 7.Components
collections.description: Component-specific color tokens aliased to 1.Semantic color modes. Covers Button, Input, Switch, Tabs, Avatar, Tooltip, Checkbox, Radio. Light and Dark modes.

collections.name: 8.Icons
collections.description: Icon size (Icon/Size/*) and stroke weight (Icon/Weight/*) tokens. Color is not stored here — icon colors live in 1.Semantic color modes under Icon/* tokens. Light and Dark modes (values are identical across modes).

styles.name: Text Styles
styles.description: 28 text styles across Display, Heading (H1–H6), Body, Caption, and Label groups. All 5 properties (fontSize, lineHeight, letterSpacing, fontFamily, fontStyle) bound to 5.Typography variables.

styles.name: Effect Styles
styles.description: 21 shadow/effect styles across Shadow/Light, Shadow/Dark, Shadow/Glass, Shadow/Blur, and Shadow/Focus Ring groups. Effect colors bound to variables. Geometry values (X/Y/blur/spread) are hardcoded — Figma does not support variable binding for these.

styles.name: Grid Styles
styles.description: 4 layout grids: Grid/MD (768px, 8 col, 24px gutter), Grid/LG (1024px, 12 col, 24px gutter), Grid/XL (1280px, 12 col, 32px gutter), Grid/2XL (1440px, 12 col, 32px gutter).

tokenArchitecture.iconColorPath: x_Primitives → 1.Semantic color modes (Icon/* tokens) — used directly, no component alias needed
rules: Raw hex lives only in x_Primitives — anything raw elsewhere is a bug
1.Semantic color modes handles all Light/Dark switching
7.Components aliases to Semantic — never directly to Primitives
8.Icons contains size and weight only — never color
